dct_description_sm: Amsterdam, ca. 1697. Ptolemaic map of Central Asia, centered on the Indus River. The map extends from the Gujarat region in the east to west of Karchi, the north to the mountains. Mercator originally published this map in his 1578 edition of Ptolemy's Geographia. -- From dealer description.; Relief shown pictorially.; Prime meridian: [Fortunate Isles].; Cartouche: title is presented inside a large, stylized oyster shell. To the left stands a woman wearing a drape about her hips, holding beaded necklaces in her hands. To the right are two men in local dress.; Probably issued in: Claudii Ptolemaei Tabulae geographicae orbis terrarum veteribus cogniti.
32 x 37 centimeters on sheet 42 x 47 centimeters
